/usr/bin/cmake -E rm -f CMakeFiles/GuitarHero.dir/objects.a
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-ar qc CMakeFiles/GuitarHero.dir/objects.a @CMakeFiles/GuitarHero.dir/objects1
/usr/bin/x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++ -Wl,--whole-archive CMakeFiles/GuitarHero.dir/objects.a -Wl,--no-whole-archive -o GuitarHero.exe -Wl,--out-implib,libGuitarHero.dll.a -Wl,--major-image-version,0,--minor-image-version,0 @CMakeFiles/GuitarHero.dir/linkLibs.rsp
